messages:
mira: Planning a canary for AcmeCorp (Dedicated / Private) tonight at 02:00 UTC. Target: rdx-serving v3.2.1-rc2 -> pin v3.2.1 for tenant during rollout. Need release lead + SRE + CS ack. Rollback gates below and a short fallback runbook. :shipit:

raj: Reviewed release notes — no schema/db changes. Runtime patch only (kernel selection + small kv-cache tweak). I'll own deploy and can stand by for escalation.

sam: SRE ack. Proposed canary plan: 10% traffic -> 5 replicas -> hold 45m -> health gate -> 50% -> full. Rollback triggers: p95 latency increase > 25% vs baseline OR aggregate error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m. Also if CPU or GPU mem OOMs.

deploy-bot: /deploy start canary tenant=acme-dedicated version=rdx-serving@v3.2.1 slice=canary replicas=5 window=45m  (initiated by raj)

olivia: CS heads-up sent to customer contacts, support on standby for the 02:00 UTC window. They requested we pin prior model if any instability.

raj: Pin config for tenant (small snippet):
```yaml
tenant: acme-dedicated
model_pin: rdx-serving@v3.2.1
canary:
  traffic_percent: 10
  replicas: 5
  hold_minutes: 45
rollback_policy:
  - name: latency_p95
    threshold_pct: 25
    duration_minutes: 5
  - name: error_rate
    threshold_percent: 0.5
    duration_minutes: 5
```

sam: Adding infra thresholds: if GPU mem > 90% for >3m or p95 > 300ms -> immediate pause and investigate. Also enable KV-cache warmup and 1min extra profiling retention.

ci-bot: Canary started at 2024-08-15T02:00:12Z. Metrics collection enabled. Run id=canary-1719512345-acme

deploy-bot: Initial health checks: 3/3 passed (serving checks, model load, kv-cache sanity). Observability hooks: latency, error_rate, gpu_mem, kv_miss_rate.

raj: Noting a small kv-cache miss spike on the first 2 minutes (expected). Holding traffic at 10%, not increasing.

sam: Observed p95 latency jump to 210ms (baseline 160ms) for ~4m window, kv_miss_rate up x2. Not yet at 25% threshold, but watching. :eyes:

raj: I'm scaling canary replicas to 7 to reduce queueing and test kernel fallbacks. Running scale command now.

deploy-bot: scale canary -> replicas=7 (in progress)

ci-bot: scale completed. New metrics steadying.

sam: After scale p95 back to 170ms, error_rate stable <0.1%. Recommend continue hold and re-run full health checks at 15m mark.

mira: Decision: keep hold at 10% for the full 45m. If metrics stay within gates, ramp to 50% and run a 20m secondary hold before full. Rollback criteria confirmed: p95 > 25% change for 5m OR error_rate >0.5% for 5m OR OOMs. Raj will execute rollback command if triggered.

olivia: Customer updated: we told them we have a 45m canary and rollback plan, CS will open an incident channel if they report anomalies.

sam: Logging note — capture full request traces for canary traffic (tag tenant=acme-dedicated) and keep traces for 7 days for postmortem.

raj: I'll also pin the tenant config in the control plane after canary completes to avoid accidental autoswitch. Command: `rdxctl tenant pin acme-dedicated rdx-serving@v3.2.1`

mira: Acks?

raj: ack :thumbsup:

sam: ack :thumbsup:

olivia: ack :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Canary hold reached 45m. Health gates: PASS. p95 change=5%, error_rate=0.08%. Ready to ramp to 50% on approval.

mira: Approve ramp to 50% and start the secondary 20m hold. Keep pin active.

deploy-bot: ramping traffic to 50% -> stage completed. Secondary hold -> 20m starting now.

sam: Monitoring. If any sign of regression we revert to pinned previous version immediately and open rollback ticket.

raj: If rollback needed: `rdxctl tenant rollback acme-dedicated --to rdx-serving@v3.2.0 --reason "canary regression"` — I have runbook steps copied to GDrive link.

olivia: CS will inform customer of final cutover timeline after the 20m window.

mira: Thanks team. Will file release notes update after full cutover.

deploy-bot: canary complete: final status=SUCCESS. No rollback triggered. :tada:
